g3-mult.explanation: Multiplication can be done in either order, so 5 × 6 = 6 × 5 = 30.

g3-mult.prompt: A spider has 8 legs. How many legs do 4 spiders have?

g3-mult.explanation: 8 × 7 = 56 — the same product as 7 × 8, just the other way round.
25 four times is 100 — like four 25p coins making £1.
g3-mult.hint: Think of quarters of a hundred.

g3-mult.prompt: A room has 6 rows of 7 chairs. If 5 chairs are removed, how many remain?
What is the 8th number in the pattern 3, 6, 9, 12, ...?
g3-mult.explanation: The pattern is multiples of 3, so the 8th is 8 × 3 = 24.

g3-fracnum.prompt: A pizza is cut into 4 equal slices and you eat 1. What fraction did you eat?
g3-fracnum.explanation: One slice out of four equal slices is 1/4.
The more pieces you cut something into, the smaller each piece. Halves are the biggest here.

g3-fracnum.prompt: How many quarters make one whole?

g3-fracnum.explanation: Two quarters is the same amount as one half.

g3-fracnum.prompt: Put these fractions in order, smallest first.
g3-fracnum.explanation: With a numerator of 1, the bigger the bottom number the smaller the fraction.

g3-fracnum.prompt: Which fraction is closest to 1 whole?
g3-fracnum.explanation: 7/8 is only 1/8 short of a whole, closer than the others.

g3-fracnum.prompt: Three friends share 2 pizzas equally. What fraction of a pizza does each get? Type the bottom number of the fraction.
g3-fracnum.explanation: Each pizza splits into thirds, so each friend gets 2/3 of a pizza. The bottom number is 3.
g3-fracnum.hint: Each pizza is split three ways.

g3-area.prompt: A rectangle is 5 squares long and 3 squares wide. What is its area in square units?
A square has sides of 4 units. What is its area in square units?
g3-area.explanation: A square's sides are equal, so area = 4 × 4 = 16 square units.
Area is the space inside. The distance around the outside is the perimeter.

g3-area.prompt: A rectangle has an area of 24 square units and is 6 units long. How wide is it?
An L-shape is made from a 3 by 2 rectangle joined to a 2 by 2 square. What is the total area in square units?
g3-area.explanation: The rectangle is 3 × 2 = 6 and the square is 2 × 2 = 4. Together 6 + 4 = 10 square units.
g3-area.hint: Work out each piece, then add.

g3-area.prompt: A rectangle has an area of 36 square units and a perimeter of 26 units. What is its longer side?
g3-area.explanation: Half the perimeter is 13, so the sides add to 13 and multiply to 36. That is 9 and 4, so the longer side is 9.
g3-area.hint: Which pair multiplies to 36 and adds to 13?

g3-div.prompt: Which division matches: 'sharing 18 stickers equally among 3 friends'?
g3-div.explanation: Sharing equally among 3 means dividing by 3: 18 ÷ 3 = 6 stickers each.

g3-div.prompt: A box has 48 pencils split evenly into 6 packs. How many pencils per pack?
A number divided by 6 gives 9 with none left over. What is the number?

g3-round.explanation: Halfway points round up, so 350 rounds to 400.
125 is halfway between 120 and 130, and halfway points round up: 130.
999 is only 1 away from 1000, so it rounds up to 1000.

g3-round.prompt: A number rounds to 400 when rounded to the nearest hundred. What is the SMALLEST whole number it could be?
g3-round.explanation: 350 is the smallest number that rounds up to 400.
The tens digit is 6, which rounds up: 3,462 rounds to 3,500.

g3-round.prompt: Which number rounds to 60 (nearest ten) AND to 100 (nearest hundred)?
g3-round.explanation: 64 rounds to 60 (nearest ten) and to 100 (nearest hundred, since it is closer to 100 than to 0). The others fail one test or the other.

g3-fraccomp.explanation: With the same denominator, more pieces means a greater fraction: 3/4 > 1/4.
Same numerator, so fewer pieces (thirds) means each piece is bigger: 2/3 > 2/5.
Cutting something into 6 pieces makes each piece smaller than cutting it into 3.
With numerator 1, the bigger the bottom number, the smaller the fraction.
Same numerator, and sixths are bigger pieces than eighths: 5/6 > 5/8.

g3-timemin.prompt: A clock shows 4:37. How many minutes until 4:45?
A movie starts at 2:50 and ends at 3:15. How many minutes long is it?
g3-timemin.explanation: 2:50 to 3:00 is 10 minutes, then 3:00 to 3:15 is 15 more: 10 + 15 = 25.
g3-timemin.hint: Count to the hour first, then the rest.

g3-timemin.explanation: 45 + 20 = 65 minutes, which is 1 hour 5 minutes past 5:00: 6:05.

g3-timemin.prompt: A train leaves at 9:05 and arrives at 9:48. How many minutes is the trip?
It is 11:52. What time will it be in 10 minutes?
A recipe takes 55 minutes and starts at 3:20. How many minutes PAST 4:00 does it finish?
g3-timemin.hint: Work out the finishing time first.

g3-timemin.prompt: Two classes are 42 minutes and 38 minutes long, back to back with no break. What is the total time, in minutes?
A bus is scheduled for 8:15 but leaves 12 minutes late, then takes 53 minutes to arrive. How many minutes after 8:15 does it arrive?
g3-timemin.explanation: The delay and the trip both add up: 12 + 53 = 65 minutes after 8:15.

g3-quads.explanation: 'Quad' means four — a quadrilateral always has 4 sides.
Any 4-sided shape, including a rectangle, is a quadrilateral.

g3-quads.prompt: Which is true of ALL squares?
g3-quads.explanation: A square is defined by having 4 equal sides AND 4 right angles.

g3-quads.prompt: A shape has 4 sides, opposite sides parallel, but no right angles. What could it be?
g3-quads.explanation: A rhombus has parallel opposite sides and equal sides, but its angles need not be right angles.

g3-quads.prompt: Which quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
g3-quads.explanation: A trapezoid is defined by having just one pair of parallel sides — the others all have two pairs.

g3-quads.prompt: Every square is a rectangle, but not every rectangle is a square. Why?
g3-quads.explanation: A rectangle only requires 4 right angles. A square adds the extra requirement that all 4 sides are equal.
choices: A rectangle does not need all 4 sides equal
A rectangle has no right angles
They are actually the same shape always

g3-quads.prompt: Which shape can be BOTH a rhombus and a square?
g3-quads.explanation: A shape with 4 equal sides is a rhombus; adding 4 right angles makes it a square too.
choices: One with 4 equal sides and 4 right angles
One with 5 sides and no right angles

g3-quads.prompt: A shape has 4 right angles. Which additional fact would make it a SQUARE rather than just a rectangle?
g3-quads.explanation: Every rectangle already has parallel sides, 4 sides and is a quadrilateral. Equal sides is the extra fact that makes it a square.
choices: It also has all 4 sides equal

g3-multprops.explanation: Commutative means the ORDER of the factors can swap without changing the product.
Associative means how the factors are GROUPED can change without changing the product.

g3-multprops.prompt: Using the commutative property, if 6 × 7 = 42, what is 7 × 6?
g3-multprops.explanation: Swapping the order of the factors never changes the product.

g3-multprops.prompt: Which shows the DISTRIBUTIVE property applied to 6 × 12?
g3-multprops.explanation: The distributive property breaks one factor into parts and multiplies each part separately.
Any number times 1 stays the same: 5 × 1 = 5.

g3-multprops.prompt: Using the distributive property, 7 × 12 = 7×10 + 7×2. What is 7×10 + 7×2?
Which expression equals 8 × 6 by regrouping the factors differently?
g3-multprops.explanation: (8 × 2) × 3 = 16 × 3 = 48, the same as 8 × 6 = 48 — just grouped differently.

g3-multprops.prompt: Using the distributive property, break 9 × 14 into 9×10 + 9×4, then find the total.

g3-twostep.prompt: Maria buys 3 packs of 4 pencils, then gives away 5 pencils. How many does she have left?
A store has 6 shelves with 8 books each. 10 books are sold. How many books remain?
Which matches: 'Buy 5 bags of 6 marbles, then lose 7 marbles'?
g3-twostep.explanation: Find the total marbles first (5 × 6), then subtract the 7 lost.

g3-twostep.prompt: A farmer has 4 rows of 9 plants. 6 plants die. How many plants are left?
A class of 24 students is split into 4 equal groups. Then 2 students join one group. How many are in that group NOW?
A baker makes 7 trays of 12 muffins. He sells 50 muffins. How many are left?
3 boxes of 15 crayons are combined with 2 more boxes of 15. How many crayons total?
A theater has 8 rows of 20 seats. 45 tickets are sold, then 60 more. How many empty seats remain?
g3-twostep.hint: Find the total seats and the total sold.

g3-patterns.prompt: What is the next number in the pattern: 5, 10, 15, 20, ___?
g3-patterns.explanation: The rule is 'add 5', so the next number is 20 + 5 = 25.

g3-patterns.prompt: What is the next number in the pattern: 2, 4, 8, 16, ___?
g3-patterns.explanation: The rule is 'double it', so the next number is 16 × 2 = 32.

g3-patterns.prompt: What is the RULE for the pattern 3, 6, 9, 12?
g3-patterns.explanation: Each number is 3 more than the one before it.

g3-patterns.prompt: What is the 6th number in the pattern 4, 8, 12, 16, ...?
g3-patterns.explanation: The rule is 'add 4' each time: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 — the 6th number is 24.
Each number in 30, 25, 20, 15 is 5 less than the one before.

g3-patterns.prompt: A pattern starts at 3 and the rule is 'add 4'. What is the 5th number?
A pattern is 1, 4, 9, 16, ___. What comes next?
g3-patterns.explanation: These are square numbers (1×1, 2×2, 3×3, 4×4), so next is 5×5 = 25.

g3-patterns.prompt: A pattern follows 'multiply by 2, then subtract 1', starting at 3: 3, 5, 9, 17, ___. What is next?

g3-add1000.prompt: A school has 615 students. 89 more enroll. How many students now?
A warehouse had 950 boxes. 378 were shipped out. How many remain?
Two numbers add to 800. One is 250 more than the other. What is the SMALLER number?
g3-add1000.hint: If the smaller is x, the larger is x + 250.

g3-mult10.prompt: A theater has 30 rows with 8 seats each. How many seats total?
A number times 20 equals 540. What is the number?

g3-fraceq.explanation: 2/4 simplifies to 1/2 — same amount, different-sized pieces.

g3-fraceq.prompt: 1/2 = __/6. What number goes in the blank?
g3-fraceq.explanation: To turn halves into sixths, multiply both parts by 3: 1×3 = 3.

g3-fraceq.prompt: Which fraction is NOT equivalent to 3/4?
g3-fraceq.explanation: 6/8, 9/12 and 12/16 all simplify to 3/4. 4/5 does not.

g3-fraceq.prompt: 2/5 = __/10. What number goes in the blank?
3/4 = 9/__. What number goes in the blank?
g3-fraceq.explanation: 3 was multiplied by 3 to get 9, so 4 must also be multiplied by 3: 4×3 = 12.

g3-fraceq.prompt: Which pair of fractions is equivalent?
g3-fraceq.explanation: 4/6 simplifies to 2/3 — they are the same amount.

g3-fraceq.prompt: Two fractions a/6 and 2/3 are equivalent. What is a?

g3-wholefrac.prompt: Which fraction equals the whole number 3?
g3-wholefrac.explanation: Any whole number n equals n/1.

g3-wholefrac.prompt: How many fourths make the whole number 2? (2 = __/4)

g3-wholefrac.explanation: 5/1 = 5, since dividing by 1 does not change the value.

g3-wholefrac.prompt: 6 = __/3. What number goes in the blank?
Which is the SAME as the whole number 1?
g3-wholefrac.explanation: Any fraction with the same numerator and denominator equals 1: 4/4 = 1.

g3-wholefrac.prompt: 4 = __/2. What number goes in the blank?
Which fraction is the SAME as 7?
A whole number n equals 24/8. What is n?

g3-perimeter.prompt: A rectangle is 6 units long and 3 units wide. What is its perimeter?
A square has sides of 5 units. What is its perimeter?
Which formula finds the perimeter of a square?
g3-perimeter.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides, so its perimeter is 4 times one side's length.

g3-perimeter.prompt: A rectangle has a perimeter of 24 units and a length of 8 units. What is its width?
g3-perimeter.hint: Half the perimeter is the sum of one length and one width.

g3-perimeter.prompt: A triangle has sides 4, 5 and 6 units. What is its perimeter?
A rectangular garden is 12 m long and has a perimeter of 34 m. What is its width?
A regular pentagon (5 equal sides) has a perimeter of 35 units. What is the length of one side?
Two rectangles share the same perimeter of 20 units. One is 6 by 4. The other has a width of 2. What is its length?
g3-perimeter.hint: Half the perimeter is length plus width.

g3-volmass.explanation: Liters measure how much liquid something holds.
Grams measure how heavy something is.

g3-volmass.prompt: A bottle holds 2 liters. Another holds 3 liters. How many liters together?
A bag of rice weighs 5 kilograms. Another weighs 3 kilograms. How many kilograms together?
Which tool measures how much liquid is in a container?
g3-volmass.explanation: A measuring cup is marked to show liquid volume.

g3-volmass.prompt: A recipe uses 250 mL of milk per batch. How many mL for 3 batches?
A crate holds 12 kilograms of apples. If 4 kilograms are removed, how many remain?
A container holds 4 liters. It is filled from a jug that pours 500 mL at a time. How many pours does it take to fill it?

g3-scaled.prompt: A scaled bar graph shows each square = 2 books. A bar has 5 squares. How many books?
Using the same scale (1 square = 2 books), how many squares would show 14 books?
On a scaled picture graph, each icon = 5 people, and there are 3 icons. How many people?
A graph's scale is 1 unit = 10 people. A bar reaches 6 units. How many people?
Why do graphs use a SCALE instead of showing every single item?
g3-scaled.explanation: A scale lets one square or icon stand for several items, so big totals still fit on the page.
choices: To fit large numbers into a manageable graph

g3-scaled.prompt: A graph's scale is 1 square = 4 items. Category A has 3 squares, Category B has 5 squares. How many MORE items does B have?
g3-scaled.explanation: B has 2 more squares than A, and 2 × 4 = 8 more items.

g3-scaled.prompt: Using scale 1 square = 3 items, how many squares would represent 21 items?
A graph uses scale 1 square = 6 items. Two EQUAL categories together use 8 squares and represent 48 items total. How many squares does EACH category use?
g3-scaled.explanation: 8 squares split evenly between 2 equal categories: 8 ÷ 2 = 4 squares each.

g3-equalarea.prompt: A rectangle is divided into 4 equal parts. Each part is what fraction of the whole?
g3-equalarea.explanation: 4 equal parts means each part is 1/4 of the whole.

g3-equalarea.prompt: A shape is divided into 3 equal areas. Each part represents ___.
g3-equalarea.explanation: 3 equal parts means each one is 1/3 of the total area.

g3-equalarea.prompt: Two SAME-SIZE rectangles are cut differently: one into 2 equal parts, the other into 4 equal parts. Which single part is BIGGER?
g3-equalarea.explanation: Fewer equal parts from the same whole always means each part is bigger.

g3-equalarea.prompt: A rectangle is split into 6 equal-area parts. What is the denominator of the fraction each part represents?
g3-equalarea.explanation: Each of the 6 equal parts is 1/6 of the whole, so the denominator is 6.

g3-equalarea.prompt: A square is divided into 4 equal-area triangles from its center. Each triangle is what fraction of the square?
g3-equalarea.explanation: 4 equal triangles means each is 1/4 of the square, regardless of their shape.

g3-equalarea.prompt: A rectangle is split into 8 equal-area parts, even though the pieces look different shapes. Each part equals ___.
g3-equalarea.explanation: Equal AREA is what matters for the fraction, even if the pieces are shaped differently.

g3-equalarea.prompt: A shape's area is 24 square units, split into 4 equal-area parts. What is the area of EACH part?
A rectangle is divided unevenly into 3 parts by area: 1/6, 1/3, and the rest. What is the THIRD part's numerator (denominator 6)?
g3-equalarea.explanation: 1/6 + 2/6 = 3/6 used, so 6/6 − 3/6 = 3/6 remains — a numerator of 3.
g3-equalarea.hint: Convert 1/3 to sixths, then see what's left of the whole.

g3-areaperim.prompt: A rectangle has the SAME perimeter as another, but they can still have ___.
g3-areaperim.explanation: Perimeter and area measure different things — matching one does not force the other to match.

g3-areaperim.prompt: Rectangle A is 6 by 2 (perimeter 16). Rectangle B is 4 by 4 (perimeter 16 too). What is Rectangle B's area?

g3-areaperim.explanation: A 6×2 rectangle and a 4×4 rectangle both have perimeter 16, but areas 12 and 16 — proof that perimeter alone doesn't fix area.
choices: Two shapes can have the same perimeter but different areas
Same perimeter always means same area
Same area always means same perimeter
Perimeter and area are the same thing

g3-areaperim.prompt: A rectangle has area 20 and one side of 4. What is its perimeter?
You stretch a rectangle to be longer and thinner while keeping the SAME area. What usually happens to the perimeter?
g3-areaperim.explanation: A longer, thinner rectangle with the same area typically has more perimeter than a squarer one.

g3-areaperim.prompt: A square and a rectangle both have area 36. The square has side 6 (perimeter 24). The rectangle is 9 by 4. Type the LARGER of the two perimeters.
g3-areaperim.explanation: The square's perimeter is 24. The rectangle's is 2 × (9 + 4) = 26, which is larger.

g3-areaperim.prompt: A rectangle has perimeter 20 and length 7. What is its area?
Two rectangles both have area 24. One is 6 by 4 (perimeter 20). The other is 8 by 3 (perimeter 22). What is the DIFFERENCE in their perimeters?
